displayName: Draft a take-home challenge for a role
summary: Write a realistic, well-scoped test with clear instructions and evaluation criteria.

useCases.title: Draft a take-home challenge for a role
useCases.message: Help me create a take-home challenge for a candidate. Ask me what the role is and what skills I want to evaluate. Then write a clear, well-scoped brief with instructions, deliverables, and the criteria I will use to assess the submission.
